quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring press release: TOKUHATSU Develops New Differential Washer to Improve (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Automotive parts: group company TOKUHATSU jointly developed with a Japanese automobile manufacturer (not named) a new differential washer for electric vehicles using its ULTRA FINE TEXTURE micro-groove press technology; it has established a mass-production system at its Sanda Plant and has already begun supplying the product to the market. The company says it matches the seizure resistance of conventional PTFE composite electroless nickel plated washers at a lower cost by eliminating the surface-treatment step.
